sentences.en: At the same time, the doctor was on the ship.
He felt the situation had become dangerous.

sentences.ar: نزل عالشط وشاف بيت خشب قديم.
sentences.en: He went ashore and saw an old wooden house.

sentences.ar: كان محاط بسور، وقالوا عليه القلعة.
sentences.en: It was surrounded by a fence, and they called it the stockade.

sentences.ar: رجع وقال: منترك السفينة ومنروح لهناك.
sentences.en: He returned and said: we leave the ship and go there.
They moved food and weapons in a small boat.
